book.name: 2 Timoti
book.title: Rau Ite Inim Ru To Paulus Imbooda Ila To Timoti 2 Timoti—2 Timothy

content: Paulus isaav ariaŋa pa Timoti

Muri pale Tiina toit Yesu Krisi imuul inim, ve ipatooŋ pooz toni ivot ighazooŋ, ve iŋgabiiz tamtoghon tisob ve ighur atia padi. Yes to tineep matadi iyaryaar, ve yes mateeŋa paam. You nasaav ariaŋa payom ila yesuru Tama Maaron matadi naghaze: Mbaŋ 10:42; 1Pe 4:5

Uvotia Maaron aliŋa pa tamtoghon irau sawa isob. Ighaze uneep ila sawa poia ve tamtoghon lolodi pa tilooŋ ghom, ma uneep ila sawa samia ve tiyasiil pa saveeŋ tiom, yom irau uyoon ariaŋa pa badooŋ pataŋani ve upatoot di kat pa Maaron aliŋa. Uvotia saveeŋ kaarom ve ŋgar samia to tamtoghon ivot ighazooŋ, ve avom iyaryaaŋ padi leso tipuli. Ve upalot di pa titaghon Maaron ŋgar toni. 1Tim 4:13; 2Tim 2:25; Tit 2:15

Pasa muri, sawa eta pale ivot, ghoro tamtoghon lolodi pa tilooŋ saveeŋ poia to itaghon Maaron ŋgar toni ne maau. Taliŋadi pale igham pa loŋaaŋ saveeŋ soroksorok moghon. Tovenen yes pale tiyou ndiran kaaromŋa katindi tinim, ve tighur di tinim patoŋaaŋ padi. Pasa, yes tiwatag: Ndiran tonowen pale tipul di titaghon taudi lolodi ve ŋgar todi. 1Tim 4:1
Sawa tonenen ighaze ivot, tamtoghon pale tipoon taliŋadi pa saveeŋ onoon to Maaron ve tipul muridi pani, ve tighur taliŋadi pa vuvuaaŋ soroksorok.

Eemoghon yom irau atem imaat, ve ugham ŋgar pooi irau sawa isob, ve uyoon ariaŋa pa badooŋ pataŋani, ve uvotia varu poia pa yes to tighur ila sone. Tinim imbees pa uraat to Maaron ighuri ilat nimam, ve ugham uraata le anoŋa ivot. 2Tim 1:8, 2:3; 1Pe 1:13
Paulus sawa toni inim igharau wa
Pasa, sawa to napul taan, nene inim igharau wa. Mala maau pale siŋ tiou imaliŋ inimale vaen to tiliŋi izala watooŋrau pogho. Pil 2:17
You naparab ariaŋa pa varu poia le nalib wa. You napariaaŋ ghou ve rismoghon, ghoro napasob landooŋ tiou tonene. Ve ghurla tiou, nene nakiskisi sone. 1Kor 9:24+; 1Tim 6:12; Hib 12:1

Tovenen atia poia to yes to tiparab ariaŋa le tilib, tauto isasaŋan ghou. Atia tonowen, nene vene: Sawa to Mboŋ Muri, Tiina toit to gabizooŋ toni deŋia moghon, ye pale ighita ghou ighaze you ŋgeu deŋiag. Ve you moghon maau. Tamtoghon tisob to lolodi pani, ve tighaze le tighita mulaaŋ toni, nene ye pale igham ŋgar raraate moghon padi. Yems 1:12; 1Pe 5:4; Syg 2:10
Paulus ipasul Timoti ighaze ila ighita rikia
O Timoti, utoova pa unum rikia.
Pasa, mbeb to taan igham Demas mata, ve ipul ghou ve ighau ila pa ndug Tesalonika wa. Ve Kresenes, ye ila pa taan suruvu to Galesia, ve Titus ila pa taan suruvu to Dalmatia. Kol 4:14; 1Yo 2:15
Ve Lukas eŋgeni, tauto yeru ninepneep. Tovenen naghaze ugham Markus, ve yamru anim. Pasa, ye irau iuul ghou kat pa uraat to Maaron. Mbaŋ 15:37+; Kol 4:10,14
Tikikus, you nambaaŋa ilat pa ndug Epesus wa.

Nonogiiŋa tiou to moŋeŋaaŋ, napuli ineep Karpus ruum toni izi ndug Troas. Sawa to ughaze unum, ghoro matam iŋgali ve ughami inim. Ve ugham rau tiou tinim paam. Ve rau tiou to tigharaat di pa ŋgai uli, nene matam iŋgal di kat, ve ugham di tinim. Lolom imaagh padi malep.
Aleksander to ŋgeu to gharatooŋ mbeb pa mbaras ve ain, ye igham ŋgar samia to iwaghamun ghou kat. Ŋgar to igham payou, muri Maaron tau pale iyati.
Tovenen matam imosmoos pooi pani. Pasa, ye izoor katin saveeŋ tiei. 1Tim 1:20

Sawa inim mata to tipayoon ghou pa navotia taug pa uraat tiou, tamtoghon eta iyoon murig ve ipariaaŋ saveeŋ tiou maau. Maau kat. Tisob tighau payou. Eemoghon you nasuŋ Maaron naghaze mata kisin sosor todi tonowen ve iyati malep.

Onoon, you eŋgengou. Eemoghon Maaron ineep toman ghou ve ipalot ghou. Tauto navotia katin varu poia pa yes to Yuda maau ne, ve tisob tilooŋa. Sawa tonenen, naghaze pale namaat. Eemoghon maau. Maaron iuul ghou, ve ipas ghou navot ila laion avo.

Ve you naghur ila ariaŋa naghaze ye pale igham mulin ghou pa ŋgar samsamia tisob to tamtoghon tighaze tigham di payou ne, ve mata payou pooi le igham ghou nala naneep tomani izi ndug toni sambam. Mbo 121:7 Ye iza tiina kat pa tapiri ve poia toni. Tovenen paitooŋ toit iŋarua irau sawa isob. To aazne ve itaghoni taghoni gha ila. Onoon.
Paesiiŋ pida to Paulus
Ugham ndag poia tiou pa Prisila yesuru Akwila, ve Onesiporus toman yes to tineep tomani ila ruum toni paam. Mbaŋ 18:2+; 2Tim 1:16+
Erastus, you napuli ineep izi ndug Korin. Ve Tropimus, ye imorooŋ ve napuli ineep izi Miletus. Mbaŋ 19:22, 20:4, 21:29

Timoti, utoova pa unum rikia. Pasa, mala maau pale ndug isami ve yauŋa tiina ivot. Eubulus, Pudes, Linus, ve Klaudia, toman toŋvetaz to Krisi tisob to yeiŋa ninepneep ne, yes tigham ndag poia todi payom.
Timoti, Tiina toit pale ineep toman ghom, ve poia toni iza to yam asob. Onoon.
